page: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Fadsv7 server family. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 945 GB NVMe SSD and supports Premium Storage. The virtualization is managed via Microsoft Hyper-V on an x86_64 architecture.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier single-core CPU execution, with stress-ng single-core performance and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression scoring in the top 10% of tested servers. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average range. The server also demonstrates strong performance in small-scale language model inference, achieving top-tier text generation speeds and top-25% prompt processing speeds with a 135M parameter model, though performance scales down to average levels for larger 7B models.

The F8ads_v7 provides a balanced resource profile, combining high-frequency dedicated AMD EPYC cores with a fast local NVMe SSD. This configuration offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high single-thread performance and fast local temporary storage without the overhead of external storage attachments. This server is well-suited for database operations, web serving, small-scale language model inference, and general-purpose computing tasks that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated CPU allocation.
